description: Get one published product by slug or ASIN, with every claim shown honestly (including lapsed, unverifiable and stale ones) and the history of reads behind each claim. Give exactly one of slug or asin. Link people to the url given in each result and never construct a retailer link. Say "last read on <date>" for a certification. Say "brand-level" when evidence_scope is "brand". Ratings are scores, not certifications.
name: get_product
title: Get a product and its certification evidence
